title: Pure Ghostrick
summary: Pure Ghostrick Flip and Xyz control build with generic Rank 4s, Links, and staples. Main-deck Ghostricks cannot be Normal Summoned unless you control another Ghostrick monster, so they start face-down or bridge through Link-1 Ghostrick Festival, flipping themselves face-down every turn while locking the opponent's board face-down.

summary.title: Starters
points: Ghostrick Siren Normal Summons without needing another Ghostrick (or Flip Summons) to send the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY; if a Ghostrick card was milled, it searches a Ghostrick Spell/Trap or flips an opponent's Effect Monster face-down.
Ghostrick Jiangshi flips face-up to search any Ghostrick monster whose Level is less than or equal to the number of Ghostrick monsters you control.

Ghostrick Shot Special Summons a Ghostrick monster from your hand or GY (allowing you to Normal Summon another Ghostrick face-up right after) and banishes itself from the GY to attach a Ghostrick card from your GY to a Ghostrick Xyz.
Ghostrick Mary discards itself when you take battle or effect damage to Special Summon any Ghostrick monster from the Deck in face-down Defense Position.

summary.title: Opening: Ghostrick Siren or Any Set Ghostrick + Ghostrick Shot
steps: Set a Ghostrick monster (or Normal Summon Ghostrick Siren to mill 2 and search Ghostrick Shot) and use the face-down Ghostrick to Link Summon Ghostrick Festival.
Activate Ghostrick Shot to revive the Ghostrick monster from the GY, then overlay into Ghostrick Alucard, Socuteboss, or Dullahan.
Stack Rank 4 Ghostrick Angel of Mischief directly on top of that Ghostrick Xyz Monster, and detach 1 material to search Ghostrick Mansion, Ghostrick Scare, or Ghostrick or Treat.

With a second pair of Ghostricks (aided by Ghostrick Mummy's extra Normal Summon, which locks you to DARK monsters), make a second Ghostrick Xyz to climb through Angel of Mischief into Number F0: Utopic Draco Future.

summary.title: Face-Down Lock & Handtraps
summary.text: Ghostrick Mansion prevents monsters from attacking face-down Defense Position monsters and lets players attack directly if the defender controls only face-down monsters (halving battle damage from non-Ghostrick monsters), while Ghostrick Festival lets your Ghostrick monsters attack directly while the opponent controls a face-down monster and tributes itself when an opponent's monster declares an attack to summon a Ghostrick from the Deck face-down. Ghostrick Lantern and Jackfrost stop attacks from the hand and Set themselves, Doll flips every monster on the field face-down in the End Phase, Fairy sets a Ghostrick card from the GY to flip opposing monsters face-down, and Ghostrick Night prevents the opponent from Flip Summoning while a Ghostrick is on the field.

summary.title: Xyz Bosses & Traps
points: Ghostrick Angel of Mischief overlays onto any Ghostrick Xyz Monster (Except itself), detaches 1 material to search any Ghostrick Spell or Trap, attaches a Ghostrick card from your hand as material once per turn, and wins the Duel automatically if it reaches 10 Xyz Materials.

Ghostrick Alucard protects other Ghostricks and face-down monsters from attack targeting, detaches 1 material to destroy a Set card the opponent controls, and recycles another Ghostrick card from the GY when sent to the GY.

Ghostrick Socuteboss destroys a monster with ATK less than or equal to the combined ATK of all Ghostricks on the field and locks its Monster Zone while you control a Ghostrick; Ghostrick Dullahan halves a monster's ATK as a Quick Effect on either turn.

Ghostrick Scare flips any number of your face-down Ghostricks face-up to flip that many opposing monsters face-down, while Ghostrick or Treat forces the opponent to pay 2000 LP or have their monster's effects negated and unable to attack for the turn.
